scene.title: Construct Perpendicular Bisector
scene.summary: Find the midpoint of a segment and draw a line through it that is perpendicular to the segment.

entities.text: The perpendicular bisector passes through the midpoint and is perpendicular to the segment.

beats.title: Draw segment AB
beats.narration: Points A and B are placed and the segment AB is drawn.

beats.title: Find midpoint M
beats.narration: The midpoint M of AB is marked at the center of the segment.

beats.title: Draw perpendicular bisector
beats.narration: A line through M perpendicular to AB is drawn, forming the bisector.

beats.title: Recap
beats.narration: The perpendicular bisector passes through M and is at 90° to AB, dividing the segment equally.
